verdict.rationale: Featurebase's own developer docs describe registrable HTTPS webhook endpoints (up to 10 per organization) that fire on feedback, conversation activity, and status changes. Deliveries carry signature headers for verification and are retried up to 3 times on failure. Missing for 10: a documented per-event catalog or selective event subscription detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Webhooks allow your backend systems to react instantly to user feedback, conversation activity, status changes, and more.
You can register up to 10 webhook endpoints per organization. All endpoints must use HTTPS for security.
To verify webhook authenticity, each request includes security headers that allow you to validate the request came from Featurebase.
If a webhook delivery fails, Featurebase will automatically retry up to 3 times
